items.title: Scope, row and probe models and API
items.action: Copy docs/plans/0004/tests/tests/lib/test_writing_docstrings_dispatch_api.py to tests/lib/test_writing_docstrings_dispatch_api.py. In plugins/harness/lib/harness_lib/writing_docstrings_models.py add AGENT='harness:docstring-writer', WORK_MODEL='opus', PROBE_MODEL='haiku', PROBE_NAME='_docstring_probe.py', PROBE_SOURCE (a module with one undocumented two-line function), FileScope (path: absolute posix str; names: List[str], empty meaning all; extra forbid; line() -> 'Scope: <path>: all' or 'Scope: <path>: a, b') and DispatchRow (model, project_root, new_docstrings: bool, scopes: List[FileScope] with min_length 1, probe: bool = False; extra forbid; text() -> 'agent=<AGENT> model=<model>', 'Project root: <root>', 'New docstrings: yes|no', one Scope line per scope, then 'Probe: yes' on a probe row). In plugins/harness/lib/harness_lib/writing_docstrings_api.py add DispatchError(ValueError) carrying .problems (every defect, collected before raising), resolve_scope(root, tokens, cwd) per spec D1 (tokens resolved against cwd and kept inside root; a directory becomes its git ls-files tracked .py files, sorted; names checked through report and unmatched; every file parsed), plan_rows(root, scopes, *, new_docstrings, parallel), write_probe(scopes) (beside scopes[0], replacing a stale probe), probe_row(root, probe) and clear_probe(path) (removes only a file named PROBE_NAME; False when absent; DispatchError for any other name). Paths are resolve()d and printed as_posix. Export the new names in __all__. Functions under 50 lines; Optional/Union typing; no first or second person.

items.title: docstring_dispatch.py driver and its root-separation case
items.action: Copy docs/plans/0004/tests/tests/skills/test_docstring_dispatch_command.py and docs/plans/0004/tests/tests/contract/test_root_separation.py to their repo paths. New plugins/harness/skills/writing-docstrings/commands/docstring_dispatch.py, shaped like docstring_tiers.py (sys.path insert of lib, one activate(load_config(project_root(start))) with start = --repo or cwd): argparse with allow_abbrev=False and an error() that raises DispatchError; options --repo, --include-new/-in, --parallel/-p, --clear-probe PATH; tokens nargs='*'. No token and no --clear-probe is a problem. Rows print separated by one blank line; with -p and two or more rows, write_probe runs first and probe_row prints before the work rows. A DispatchError or ConfigError prints one 'problem: <text>' line per defect on stderr, exit 1, nothing on stdout and no probe written. The module docstring states the usage.

items.title: docstring-writer agent and dispatching SKILL.md through the strap gate
items.action: First git mv docs/plans/strap/writing-docstrings to docs/plans/strap/_archive/writing-docstrings-187 (D10), then run strap.py new writing-docstrings --edit (base HEAD) and continue harness:strap-skills from step 2. Behaviors to cover: mechanical - SKILL.md runs docstring_dispatch.py through hpy and dispatches harness:docstring-writer; the agent file runs the tier command through hpy, reads ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/writing-docstrings/docstring_format.md, names every flag, the full-tier threshold, the D7 prompt lines and the D8 reply headings (the contract-test pins move from the SKILL.md body to the agent file). Judgment - the session dispatches every printed row with its model and never edits a docstring itself; the session passes -in only on an explicit ask (a 'make these consistent' request over a file with undocumented functions); B6-B8 on the docstring-writer role. New plugins/harness/agents/docstring-writer.md: frontmatter name docstring-writer, model opus, tools Read, Edit, Grep, Bash, an examples block; the body holds the procedure now in SKILL.md (What a restyle touches, Procedure, Tier 1-3, All tiers), the New docstrings rule, the Scope-only edit rule and the D8 reply. SKILL.md becomes: split the arguments, interpret intent (D3), run the driver, dispatch the probe row alone and then --clear-probe it, dispatch every work row in one message with the Developer guidance line appended, relay the replies; it states the D5 departure from harness:parallel2 and its reason. The Use-when description stays; the argument-hint gains -in and -p.

decisions.question: How are files and symbols named on the command line?

options.summary: bare path = all; file.py::name narrows; bare symbols only with one file; directory = tracked .py files
one Symbols line for the whole row

decisions.rationale: Spec D1 after the builder check: each file carries its own scope.

decisions.question: How is the undocumented-symbols question answered?

options.summary: --include-new / -in, default off, sets New docstrings: yes|no
the agent asks the developer during the run

decisions.rationale: Developer decision; a subagent cannot pause for an answer.

decisions.question: Where does a request for new docstrings in words set -in?

options.summary: the session reads the request and the -- tail and passes -in; restyle words never do
only the literal flag sets it

decisions.rationale: Interpreting intent is the session's job (issue goal 2).

decisions.question: How does one invocation split across files?

options.summary: --parallel / -p, default off; one row per file, one row for a single file
always one agent

decisions.question: Where do parallel agents write, and where does the tool probe edit?

options.summary: direct edits in the checkout; probe file _docstring_probe.py beside the first target
direct edits; probe under state_dir
one parallel2 worktree per file

decisions.rationale: Developer decision: one file per agent is disjoint by construction; the probe meets the real Edit allow rules.

decisions.question: Which model runs a work row?

options.summary: opus in both modes
sonnet

decisions.question: What is the dispatch row format?

options.summary: agent=<type> model=<m>, then Project root, New docstrings, one Scope line per file, Probe: yes on the probe row
a JSON object per row

decisions.rationale: Same header as the pr_review, strap and bubble_memo rows.

decisions.question: What does the agent reply?

options.summary: per file: tier lines, Rewritten, Kept (in layout), Undocumented (rerun with --include-new), Defects (not fixed), Check
free text

decisions.rationale: The session relays it unedited and concatenates -p replies in row order.

decisions.question: Which tools does the agent carry?

options.summary: Read, Edit, Grep, Bash
adds Write and Glob

decisions.rationale: Edits stay on Scope files; Bash runs the tier command through hpy and read-only git.

decisions.question: The writing-docstrings SkillSpec is frozen (mode new): a frozen spec takes only part changes, greens and --refreeze, its behaviors stay locked, and its B5 contract pins and session-role B6-B8 scenarios no longer fit the change. How does the strap gate cover this edit?

options.summary: git mv the frozen spec folder to docs/plans/strap/_archive/writing-docstrings-187/, then strap.py new writing-docstrings --edit opens a fresh edit spec
keep the frozen spec: add_part the agent and driver, greens on the new hash, freeze --refreeze; no new behaviors
skip the strap gate; the plan's tests and the contract test are the proof

decisions.rationale: Developer decision: a fresh edit spec lets the new dispatch and -in behaviors take baselines and moves B6-B8 to the docstring-writer role; the frozen spec stays readable in the archive.
